_source: de Leva (1996) adjustments to Zatsiorsky-Seluyanov anthropometric tables, male values
_note: massFrac: fraction of total body mass. comFrac: center of mass location as a fraction of segment length from the proximal joint. relDensity: segment density relative to water (1.0), used for center-of-buoyancy estimation and is an approximate literature-informed value, not measured per-subject.
